changelog:
Initial release: Unified end-to-end workflows for multimodal image, video, and audio generation and understanding via SkillBoss API Hub.

- Supports text-to-image, image editing, and multi-turn image workflows.
- Enables image, video, and audio input understanding (caption, classification, Q&A, summaries, transcription).
- Provides video generation (text-to-video) and TTS speech generation with control over style and pacing.
- All routes unified through SkillBoss API Hub with simple authentication and routing.
- Includes Node.js and REST (curl) code templates for each capability.
